content.short: CryptoCadet is a no-code altcoin payment router for accepting payments on Gmail and other platforms.
content.description: CryptoCadet is a no-code altcoin payment router that acts as a bridge rather than a payment processor. It enables paying with and accepting altcoins on the same platforms that support major cryptocurrencies, expanding where altcoins can be used and accepted. By unlocking new use cases and channels for altcoins, CryptoCadet seeks to boost their utility and transaction volume without requiring separate payment rails. The platform also makes it straightforward to design and run affiliate or loyalty programs and to pay affiliates instantly with minimal effort.
